children: Equity Bancshares has agreed to buy fellow bank-holding company Lincoln Bancorp for about $123.8 million in cash and stock in a deal that would expand its presence in Iowa.
Equity on Thursday said Lincoln, based in Reinbeck, Iowa, has 16 locations and total assets of $1.7 billion.
Equity said the deal consideration would include about 77.5% stock and roughly 22.5% cash.
The Wichita, Kan., company said the acquisition, slated to close by the end of the year, would bring its total assets to more than $9 billion.
